name: qemu-w64-setup
verification: qemu.org/download/#windows links to https://qemu.weilnetz.de/w64/, the official 64-bit Windows builds by Stefan Weil. The newest file there on 2026-10-02 was this one, listed as 'New QEMU installer (11.1.0)'.
The URL uses the dated 2026/ directory: the top-level w64/ directory keeps only the latest few installers, and the yearly directory keeps every one of them.

sha512 is the one published next to the installer (sha512_url). sha256 was computed locally from the same download, after checking that its SHA-512 matched the published one. invisible-dots setup verifies sha256 before it runs the installer.
The download was extracted with 7-Zip and its binaries report 'QEMU emulator version 11.1.0' and 'qemu-img version 11.1.0'. 'qemu-system-x86_64 -accel help' lists tcg and whpx.

The installer is NSIS 3 Unicode (7-Zip reports Type = Nsis, NSIS-3 Unicode). Its script, qemu.nsi in the QEMU source tree, has no SilentInstall directive, so the standard NSIS /S switch runs it silently. It sets RequestExecutionLevel admin, which is why setup runs it inside the single elevated session.

qemu.nsi sets 'InstallDir $PROGRAMFILES64\qemu': install_subdir under %ProgramW6432%, which is where invisible-dots looks first. If QEMU was installed before, InstallDirRegKey HKLM Software\qemu64 Install_Dir takes precedence; setup reads that value back after the installer ran and names the directory when it is another one. The 'Tools' section (qemu-img.exe) and the 'System Emulations' group are selected by default, so /S installs both binaries.

The Authenticode signature (signer: Universitaet Mannheim) is reported by Get-AuthenticodeSignature as outside its certificate's validity period, so the signature cannot be the trust anchor; the pinned sha256 is.
To move to a newer build: download it from the same directory, check it against its .sha512, update version, build, url, size_bytes, sha256, sha512 and sha512_url together.
